authority: 03-specification-delta.md §§8,13; PRV/ID/UNI requirements and exact BDD tags in Implementation-Plan-V4/features/02_identity_privacy_and_access.feature; owner/legal approval assumed by explicit user direction 2026-11-07.
rule: Only fields explicitly required by an accepted scenario may be persisted. Candidate fields are not implementation authorization by themselves. A row marked no_current_entity is a WP3.3 design input; do not silently add a table or field.

mappings.behavior: Require recorded consent for cooperative_record_keeping before personal data entry.
command_or_transition: reject member personal-data command without required consent
mappings.lawful_basis: Consent only for consent-dependent fields; do not treat as universal basis.
mappings.retention: Per-category retention_policies policy; no value inferred by this mapping.
mappings.status: existing candidate schema; API/DB behavior belongs to WP3.3

mappings.behavior: Record withdrawal and begin configured retention evaluation; stop identifier display absent another lawful purpose.
mappings.lawful_basis: Withdrawal ends the specified consent basis only; independently sourced legal obligation is evaluated separately.
mappings.retention: Policy-controlled per data category, including recorded legal/retention conflict review.
mappings.status: candidate state exists; transition/job behavior belongs to WP3.3/WP3.4

mappings.behavior: Store identifiers encrypted, use only keyed blind indexes for duplicate review, preserve reissued identifier linkage, and never auto-merge people.
audience: authorized identity officer for masked/reveal-on-need view
mappings.lawful_basis: Field-specific basis from the source-backed purpose; do not derive from the blind index.
mappings.retention: Identifier category policy; active/replica/backup behavior must be separately evidenced.
mappings.status: existing schema candidate; ciphertext/provider and duplicate-review proof belongs to WP3.2

mappings.behavior: Mask member identifiers for authorized officers and omit them entirely for union/TA, PFI, and unrelated-cooperative audiences.
audience: Secretary/internal verifier: masked; union/TA/PFI/other cooperative: absent
mappings.lawful_basis: Read authorization is not created by the existence of stored ciphertext.
mappings.status: projection/access contract; WP3.3 API response canaries and WP6.3 rendered views

mappings.behavior: Events and logs carry no raw PII/NRC-shaped values and reference people only by pseudonymous ID.
command_or_transition: event serialization and application log redaction
audience: event consumers and operational log readers receive no member PII
mappings.lawful_basis: Not applicable to event/log payload; do not serialize personal fields.
mappings.retention: Event retention per audit policy; logs per operational policy, both without raw PII.

mappings.behavior: After configured retention, personal fields become undecryptable while pseudonymous transaction facts remain and conflict review is visible.
audience: authorized privacy officer; transaction readers see pseudonymous identity only
mappings.lawful_basis: No legal outcome is inferred; preserve source-scoped needs_legal_validation on unresolved exceptions.
mappings.retention: Per-category policy; numeric durations and exception outcomes must come from approved source/policy, not test fixture.
mappings.status: policy/evidence map; provider lifecycle belongs to WP3.4; current local provider is not durable shred proof

mappings.behavior: Read-only inspection shows only applicable register/by-law data and records a privacy-safe inspection observation.
current_entity_fields: bylaw_documents / bylaw_versions / bylaw_provisions for by-law inspection; no member-inspection session entity exists in current migrations
command_or_transition: read-only inspection session; no source mutation
audience: public inspector or member sees only the applicable statutory register fields; by-law reader sees by-law version/status only
mappings.lawful_basis: Feature cites public statutory inspection and member inspection; owner/legal approval is assumed, and only scenario-scoped fields are permitted.
mappings.retention: Inspection audit retention is policy-controlled; log inspector and receipt reference only where the scenario requires, no other members' PII.
mappings.status: member inspection session/policy needs WP3.3 mapping; visible route and assertions belong to WP6.3

mappings.behavior: In test profile, accept only the documented synthetic NRC pattern; reject non-synthetic patterns.
audience: server validation; generic reason to caller
mappings.lawful_basis: Synthetic-only control, not a claim about real-data identity validity.
mappings.retention: Test fixture lifecycle; no real identity data is permitted.
mappings.status: domain/API validation belongs to WP3.1; do not treat client validation as enforcement

mappings.behavior: Real-data startup refuses an unapproved residency region before readiness.
current_entity_fields: No personal-data row is created by this guard; residency is deployment configuration and readiness evidence.
audience: operators receive classified refusal without secrets
mappings.lawful_basis: Approved-region source/configuration must be recorded; no region value invented here.

mappings.behavior: Purge tenant data and restore deterministic seeds while preserving catalogues and a durable successful audit.
current_entity_fields: purge allowlist is defined from complete migration inventory; successful purge audit ledger is outside allowlist
audience: dedicated test operator; no ordinary app role
mappings.retention: Test database reset; successful audit remains durable according to operational policy.

mappings.behavior: Keep statutory register fields under the stated legal_obligation basis distinct from consent-dependent identifier fields; public inspection exposes only scenario-listed fields and a privacy-safe session audit.
current_entity_fields: No member register entity currently exists in root migrations; scenario names name, address, occupation, shares, date_registered, and inspection session inspector_name, fee_receipt_reference, occurred_at, fields_shown.
command_or_transition: fee receipt reference recorded; Symphony does not process payment
audience: public sees name/address/occupation/date_registered only; no identifier/contact/share amount/sensitive fields
mappings.lawful_basis: Feature explicitly distinguishes statutory s.28 fields as legal_obligation from identifier consent; payment is external and only receipt reference is stored.
mappings.retention: Member-register and inspection-audit category policies; no numeric value inferred by this map.
mappings.status: candidate fields are exactly those required by scenario, not approved schema; WP3.3 must map source/command/retention before persistence and WP6.3 exercises rendered route

mappings.behavior: Another member's individual account records require that member's written consent evidence or general-meeting resolution; own society books remain inspectable by authorized officers/members/delegates.
current_entity_fields: No individual-account inspection entity exists in current migrations; existing consent_records.evidence_ref is only a candidate evidence reference, not proof of written consent semantics.
command_or_transition: record scoped written-consent evidence or general-meeting resolution reference
authorize only that member's account rows
audience: requesting person sees only authorized target member's account
mappings.lawful_basis: Scenario cites Act s.59(2); owner/legal validation is assumed for the supplied baseline only.
mappings.retention: Account/inspection evidence category policy; preserve source-specific holds/conflicts.
mappings.status: no current entity or API; WP3.3 must not infer a generalized consent portal and WP6.3 owns route behavior

global_exclusions: No production-grade crypto-shred claim from the local provider
No persistence for a candidate field without a mapped Phase 1 acceptance behavior
